Results.ReviewText: Love my new Weber grill. Perfect size for a couple or small cookout with guests. Weber quality is built in and support from Weber in documentation and online support is fabulous.
Results.Title: Great grill with built-in quality and support

Results.ReviewText: This grill is perfect for someone who has 2-3 family members.  It will easily hold 12 burgers plus hot dogs at once.
Results.Title: Perfect size

Results.ReviewText: Best grill we’ve owned. Perfect size for the two of us with enough room to cook for guests as well. This grill gives us much more evenly distributed, consistent heat than the previous cheaper brands we’ve had in the past.
Results.Title: Excellent grill

Results.ReviewText:
I like the foot print as far as size for grilling area.
The tank hanger/scale is clever for a visual of usage and remaining fuel is helpful.
Results.Title: Newest Weber

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback and for being a Weber fan! We are glad to learn that you are loving your new grill, although we apologize for the frustration with your electronic ignition.

Usually, a simple tweak in the lighting procedure or moving the electrode will get everything working properly.

Our Care team is here to help troubleshoot the issue. Please look for our email outreach soon!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: The grille is a perfect size for two people. The only complaint, the grill does not light automatically.  The gas builds up but the igniter does not light  the does not light the grill on the first one or two clicks. If it lights, there is a large amount of gas build up  ….. I have to use a lighter to light a brand new grill.
Results.Title: Grill does not light properly

Results.ReviewText: I've owned Webber grills in the past, and the E-210 certainly lives up to my expectations.   I like that the shelves fold down to make a smaller footprint for storage, but the grill is big enough for six good size ribeye's.   The grill heats up HOT very fast and chars just right.   I would recommend it for anyone that wants a medium sized grill.
Results.Title: Small footprint with Big results

Results.ReviewText: compact, starts right up. The cover keeps out the elements
Results.Title: weber again

Results.ReviewText:
I'm 73 years old and have purchased many grills over the years. I've learned that you buy a top notch grill like this Weber E-210 and you save money in long run. I expect to get 10 years of great grilling from this grill. I've received only 2 to 3 years on other grills I've purchased in the past. 
This grill saves money over time.
Results.Title: So far, the best grill I've owned.

Results.ReviewText: This grill is a trooper! I bought one when we moved over five years ago and just now had to replace it. After doing some research, I discovered that the “less expensive “ ones on the market are only lasting about a year. Though I believe the price is a bit high, the quality supports its cost..
Results.Title: Great grill & worth the money!

Results.ReviewText: Great looking and performing grill. Love the propane tank gauge. The grates work well and this thing lights up immediately. Castors roll effortlessly, yet can be locked if needed. We also bought the matching grill cover, and it seems nice (future durability unknown after only a couple weeks), and it fits perfectly. I’ve never had a grill cover fit so well. Temperature controls seem like they have a wide adjustment range, and it works well both with direct grilling and with indirect heat.
Results.Title: Impressive looks and performance

Results.ReviewText: We have had multiple grills in the past.  This grill surpasses every other one.  It cooks very evenly and has outstanding results.  We will never buy another brand again!
Results.Title: Best grill we have ever purchased

Results.ReviewText: It’s so easy to use.  The two burner Spirit is plenty big enough for a medium size family.
Results.Title: Easy peasy

Results.ReviewText:
Why does the meat always stick to the grids and why is it so difficult to clean the grids.
Should they have oil of some kind on them before cooking. I would really like an answer
Results.Title: Meat makes the grids look old and dirty

Results.ReviewText: Had a Webber awhile back but then bought a Nextgrill. At the time the price seemed right but as someone said, it was a disposable grill.  My previous Webber had lasted 10 years.  I have had my new grill for 2 months and it is night and day in quality Bs my previous grill.  You get what you pay for.  The grill is easy to use, clean up is easy and I have been very pleased.
Results.Title: You get what you pay for

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill works great so far only had couple months! Be nice if it came with cover for price. Folding sides are nice to save space. Looks easy to clean have not done that yet!
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use!  I’ve grilled, smoked, and rotisseried on it.  Love it!
Results.Title: Great little grill!

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber Grill and I'm delighted! The Spirit E-210 is the perfect size for my small deck and the fold down sides make more room. I'm impressed with how well my food has grilled. The placement of the drip pans make clean-up extremely easy and since there is a door, the drip pan is now inaccessible to my dogs...they aren't happy about that though!
Results.Title: Love my grill

Results.ReviewText: My Spirit E-210 has been a welcome addition to my cooking. Love the drop down shelves to conserve space when covered when not in use. Plenty big cooking area for all my needs. I added a rotisserie to complete my grilling requirements. Great quality as expected!
Results.Title: Spirit

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use and the controls are simple. Love the hook for the tank that lets you know how full the tank is.
Results.Title: Great Grill Good Price

Results.ReviewText: More than happy with my purchase. Love everything about this grill. Love the tank monitor.
Results.Title: Excited to grill

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill it is my second BBQ of the same version.  Last one lasted 8 years with weber maintenance. We use it 5 days a week all year long.
Results.Title: Love my Spirit E-210

Results.ReviewText:
We bought our BBQ about a month ago, challenging to assbemble but had a neighbour assist us along with the tutorial on Weber website, very helpful.
Grills food to perfection!! Love it and the size is just right for us.
Results.Title: Happy With Our Weber Spirit E-210

Results.ReviewText: We like very much our new Spirit E-210 gas grill for all it has to offer - its efficiency and rapid warmup, the grilling surface which is very close to our 3 burners old Weber, yet takes less space for storage. The folding sides make a great design for using less space and ease of handling. We will recommend it to all our friends and relatives.
Results.Title: Great design grill

Results.ReviewText: Excellent machine.  We’ve had one at the beach.  14 years outside. No rust, no wear.  Excellent.
Results.Title: Built to last

Results.ReviewText: So far so good - this is a great grill - always starts and easy to control the heat
Results.Title: Really worth it so far would buy again

Results.ReviewText: Love it , first time buying the weber. My friend has one.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Very nice sized grill. Not a lot of room inside for storing grill cleaning tools, bot not a major issue. Being able to flip grates for flatter or for less contact (with food) is a definite plus.
Results.Title: A Generally Great Grill

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
